entities.name: James
entities.description: One of the two friends in this conversation: a programmer and lifelong gamer who works with Python and C++, makes games and game mods, keeps three dogs (Max, Daisy and Ned), supports Liverpool, travels when he can, and started dating Samantha in September 2022. He and John have been friends since elementary school.

entities.name: John
entities.description: The other friend in this conversation: he signed up for a programming course in March 2022, left an IT job of three years in mid-2022 for a new job, and turned towards organising esports tournaments, volunteering his coding skills, chess and board games. He teaches his younger siblings and his parents to code, has known James since they were about ten, and has no pets but wants one.

entities.name: Max
entities.description: One of James's dogs, together with Daisy and later Ned. Lovable and playful, a strong swimmer at the beach and lake, never misses a frisbee in mid-air, and James's companion on the trail a mile from his house.

entities.name: Daisy
entities.description: One of James's dogs, together with Max and later Ned. A Labrador who loves her toys and, most of all, eating, and who lies down next to James while he is gaming.

entities.name: James's notebook
entities.description: The notebook James keeps: in March 2022 for writing down all his goals, which he finds satisfying to check off one by one, and from September 2022 for writing down everything he has to do so as not to forget it.

entities.name: The dog walking and pet care app
entities.description: The app James and John talked about building together on 17 March 2022: it would connect pet owners with reliable dog walkers and offer pet care information, and its personal touch would let each owner record their dog's own preferences and needs. Nothing later in the conversation says it was built.

entities.name: James's childhood game project
entities.description: The computer game James has wanted to make since he was a child, when he drew its main character in comics; he described it on 17 March 2022 as the project he was most excited about. Joined here with the project he had been working on for weeks and nearly finished on 29 April 2022, when a bug in the code broke its game mechanics and a group of friends helped him fix it.

entities.name: The Witcher 3
entities.description: The game James was most into in March 2022, praised for its story and atmosphere. It inspired the virtual world he built in April 2022 and the first game he released in October 2022; John had not played it in March 2022 and was hooked on it by August 2022.

entities.name: Bowling
entities.description: The game James loves and got two strikes at on 16 March 2022. John does not like it and says his fingers are too big for it, so they looked for something else to do together.

entities.name: John's programming course
entities.description: The programming class John signed up for on 17 March 2022 to refresh the HTML and CSS he had learned a few years earlier. He met three new friends there on 19 April 2022, and his younger siblings later joined the same course.

entities.name: Metal detecting
entities.description: The hobby John took up shortly before 20 March 2022, walking along beaches with a metal detector he bought. He has found mostly bottle caps, a couple of times coins, and once a gold ring.

entities.name: Playing the drums
entities.description: Playing the drums. On 27 March 2022 John said he had been playing for a month and James said he had started a few days earlier and practised daily; on 18 September 2022 John instead spoke of having played drums when he was younger and not for a while.

entities.name: James's gaming setup
entities.description: James's gaming equipment: the cutting-edge system with incredible graphics he got in March 2022, a gaming PC with keyboard, mouse and a comfortable chair, and a new video card he got in the week before 3 October 2022.

entities.name: CS:GO
entities.description: John's favourite shooter. He played it in a tournament at a gaming convention in March 2022, organised a charity CS:GO tournament with friends on 7 May 2022, and named it first among the games he wanted to organise state competitions for.

entities.name: Apex Legends
entities.description: James's favourite game to play with his team, which he praises for its graphics and very fast-paced gameplay. Also one of the games played at John's charity tournament on 30 October 2022.

entities.name: Ned
entities.description: The puppy James adopted from a shelter in Stamford in the week before 12 April 2022, referred to in later sessions as 'my puppy' and 'my dog'. Introduced to Max and Daisy on 17 June 2022, and taken to the clinic on 5 August 2022 for a routine examination and a vaccination against a seasonal canine disease.

entities.name: Stamford
entities.description: The town whose animal shelter James adopted the puppy Ned from in April 2022.

entities.name: The Witcher 3-inspired virtual world
entities.description: The virtual world James built with one of his gaming friends on 14 April 2022, combining programming and gaming and inspired by The Witcher 3. He showed John the game character he created for it, whose appearance he based on a woman he passed while walking his dogs.

entities.name: Italy
entities.description: A country James visited in 2021 and called very beautiful, with delicious food. John said he had always dreamed of going there.

entities.name: Turkey
entities.description: One of the three countries James had visited as of April 2022, along with Italy and Mexico.

entities.name: Mexico
entities.description: One of the three countries James had visited as of April 2022, along with Italy and Turkey.

entities.name: Japan
entities.description: The last country John had visited as of 20 April 2022. He was impressed by its technologically advanced megacities, the huge screens on the buildings and the street food.

entities.name: Walking and hiking with the dogs
entities.description: Walking and hiking with his dogs, which James does regularly: a trail hike on 21 April 2022, long walks with Max on the trail a mile from his house, and a beach outing with all three dogs on 9 August 2022.

entities.name: The small business website John built
entities.description: The website John built as a freelancer for a local small business from April 2022, his first professional project outside his programming class. Progress was slow and the hardest part was working out how to take payments on it.

entities.name: Assassin's Creed Valhalla
entities.description: The game John was playing at the end of April 2022 and called cool.

entities.name: Civilization VI
entities.description: The turn-based strategy game James had been playing for a month as of 29 April 2022, managing resources, leading armies and conquering territories. He named Civilization as the model for the strategy game he wanted to make and finished in September 2022.

entities.name: The Kingkiller Chronicle
entities.description: The fantasy series John recommended to James on 29 April 2022 as 'The Name of the Wind', calling it a trilogy, and named again on 16 June 2022 as one of his two favourite series. Treated here as one work under both names.

entities.name: James's gaming group
entities.description: The group of gaming friends James plays with regularly. A group of them teamed up with him in late April 2022 to fix the bug in his game project, they stream their sessions, they had a get-together in August 2022, and he hosted an all-night gaming marathon with them.

entities.name: Volunteering
entities.description: Volunteering, which John turned to through 2022: building a software tool for a charitable foundation in May 2022, raising money for a dog shelter and for a children's hospital through gaming tournaments, and being offered a mentoring role at a game development non-profit in October 2022. James volunteers too, with an organisation that gives necessities to people in need.

entities.name: The charitable foundation John built software for
entities.description: The charitable foundation, passionate about helping children, whose paper records and manual inventory John replaced in May 2022 with a smartphone application he built and gave them.

entities.name: The charity inventory application
entities.description: The smartphone application John built for a charitable foundation in May 2022, replacing paper records and manual stocktaking with tracking of inventory, resources and donations, and reports for analysis.

entities.name: James's game development course
entities.description: The course James started before 13 June 2022 that combines his passion for gaming with programming. On it he worked on a new part of a football simulator, collecting the player databases. He said he chose it mainly to improve himself, and that its football subject was a bonus.

entities.name: Liverpool FC
entities.description: The football club James supports. He says there is no sport better than football and no club better than Liverpool, does not miss a single match, and hoped on 13 June 2022 that they would be champions the following season.

entities.name: Manchester City
entities.description: The football club John supports. On 13 June 2022 he bet James that City would finish above Liverpool, while James said City were in bad form with a terrible transfer policy.

entities.name: John's coding blog
entities.description: The blog about coding John started in the week before 16 June 2022. He calls it exciting and a little scary, a way to share and track his coding journey and to connect with other coders.

entities.name: Reading
entities.description: Reading, John's way of relaxing and escaping into an author's world; he is a big fan of science fiction and epic fantasy and nearly filled his bookcase with new books in June 2022. James reads too, especially under the covers on a cold winter day, and takes a book to the park.

entities.name: The Stormlight Archive
entities.description: One of John's two favourite fantasy series, recommended to James on 16 June 2022 for its magical world and characters that feel real.

entities.name: The Expanse
entities.description: The science fiction series John recommended to James on 16 June 2022, calling it epic.

entities.name: The trail a mile from James's house
entities.description: The trail a mile from James's house where he and Max take long walks; he calls it tranquil and a good way to relax and connect with nature, and the park there is where he goes alone with a book.

entities.name: The organisation James volunteers with
entities.description: The organisation James volunteered with in May 2022, which provides necessary items to people who are less fortunate. On 19 June 2022 John asked James to take him there, and James said no interview would be needed and offered to introduce him to staff he knew.

entities.name: Extreme sports
entities.description: The extreme sports James took up in the summer of 2022 as a break from his usual hobbies: rope jumping, his highest jump from 150 metres on 8 July 2022, and surfing on 6 July 2022, which he found strangely relaxing.

entities.name: Toronto
entities.description: The Canadian city James bought air tickets to and flew out to on the evening of 11 July 2022.

entities.name: Vancouver
entities.description: The other Canadian city James planned to visit on his July 2022 trip.

entities.name: Canada
entities.description: The country James travelled to on 11 July 2022, visiting Toronto and planning to visit Vancouver. John called it the fourth country James would have visited.

entities.name: Chess
entities.description: The game John took up on 22 July 2022 to get better at strategy, calling it an endless puzzle. He plays mostly online and practises at a chess club, took James's advice to study openings and analyse his own games, and won a regional tournament on 1 November 2022.

entities.name: John's chess club
entities.description: The chess club John joined after taking up chess in July 2022, where he practises against other players alongside playing online.

entities.name: Skateboarding
entities.description: What James and John were into as ten-year-olds, when they and a group of friends often went to the skate park, helped each other learn tricks and sometimes left class early for it. James still rides occasionally and has taught his dogs to balance on a board.

entities.name: Nuuk
entities.description: The city James also got to during his July 2022 trip, staying only briefly; he counted it as one more country on his list.

entities.name: Greenland
entities.description: The country whose city Nuuk James visited briefly during his July 2022 trip.

entities.name: Jill
entities.description: Someone close to John, for whom James brought back a souvenir from his July 2022 trip; John said she would be delighted. The conversation says nothing else about her.

entities.name: James's sister
entities.description: James's sister, who came to see him on 21 July 2022 and spent the day with him and his dogs, and watched a sunset with him by the ocean. James says he is blessed to have a close bond with her and that they are like family.

entities.name: John's siblings
entities.description: John's younger siblings, taken as a group; the conversation never names them individually. They live far apart from him so they plan gaming nights when they meet, they threw him an all-night gaming marathon when he was younger, they joined the same programming course, and by September 2022 they were writing their own basic games and stories with his help.

entities.name: Organising gaming tournaments
entities.description: Organising gaming tournaments and competitions, which John did for charity on 7 May 2022 and 30 October 2022 and with programmer friends in October 2022, and which he decided on 6 August 2022 to make his career, starting with CS:GO and Fortnite competitions in his state.

entities.name: Fortnite
entities.description: One of the games John wanted to host competitions for, and the main game played at the charity tournament he held on 30 October 2022.

entities.name: Samantha
entities.description: The woman James met at the dog beach outing on 9 August 2022, who left him her phone number. He asked her to be his girlfriend at the theatre on 3 September 2022 and she agreed; she loves the theatre and a good lager, and by 31 October 2022 they had decided to move in together and rented an apartment near McGee's bar.

entities.name: John's online programming group
entities.description: The online programming group John joined on 19 August 2022, full of skilled coders passionate about using technology for good. He exchanged contacts with several members and worked with one of them on a project, though he called that a one-off.

entities.name: John's gaming setup
entities.description: John's gaming setup: a gaming PC with a powerful graphics card, a gaming chair, keyboard and headset. He bought new devices and refurbished the desk in August 2022, and added Sennheiser headphones and a Logitech mouse in September 2022.

entities.name: McGee's pub
entities.description: The pub James and John agreed to meet at on 27 August 2022 after John turned down Starbucks; James had heard it serves a great stout and John, who dislikes dark beer, settled for a light one. James and Samantha drink there, and its nearness was one of their criteria when they rented an apartment together in October 2022.

entities.name: James's Unity strategy game
entities.description: The strategy game James built in the Unity engine, modelled on Civilization and Total War. On 26 August 2022 he said he was dying to make one; on 1 September 2022 he announced it finished, saying the hardest part was balancing the mechanics and keeping it fair.

entities.name: John's parents
entities.description: John's parents, taken as a group. They started learning to code from him around 4 September 2022, which he said brings them closer; he photographed his father writing his first program.

entities.name: James's cooking class
entities.description: The cooking class James signed up for on 2 September 2022, at $10 a lesson, having never liked cooking but wanting to learn something new. At the first lesson he made an omelette he was proud of and a meringue, and was taught how to make dough.

entities.name: Dungeons of the Dragon
entities.description: The board game John tried in the week before 18 September 2022 and found very exciting; it was what got him into board games.

entities.name: Streaming games
entities.description: Streaming games, which James started around 18 September 2022 with no details settled. When he streamed on the evening of 19 September 2022 the gaming community's comments amazed him and left him inspired to keep going; his gaming group also streams its sessions.

entities.name: John's portable smoker startup
entities.description: The startup making portable smokers that John began on 19 September 2022, having already welded one out of metal himself.

entities.name: John's first mobile game
entities.description: John's first mobile game, a 2D adventure with puzzles and exploration that he worked on secretly for the past few months and announced finished on 20 September 2022, due to launch in October 2022. A book on game design helped him build its puzzles, and James offered to test it.

entities.name: The game development magazine
entities.description: The magazine of tutorials, developer interviews and tips that James recommended to John on 20 September 2022 and that John said he already reads; both call it a useful resource for improving their game development.

entities.name: The game development non-profit
entities.description: The game development non-profit that emailed John in early October 2022 offering him a volunteer role as a programming mentor for game developers, teaching coding and assisting with their projects.

entities.name: Cyberpunk 2077
entities.description: The game John recommended to James on 3 October 2022 as immersive with an amazing story, and which James tried on 20 October 2022 and found great and addictive. John warned him the hardest part is making the right choices, even in dialogue.

entities.name: The first game James released
entities.description: The first game James made and released to the gaming community, announced on 13 October 2022; he found it fulfilling to see players engage with the world he had created, and said The Witcher 3 was a big inspiration. He did not say whether it was the Unity strategy game he finished on 1 September 2022, whose inspirations he named as Civilization and Total War, so the two are kept apart here.

entities.name: James's mother
entities.description: James's mother, who came to see him on 19 October 2022 with an army friend of hers and had fun with him.

entities.name: The army friend of James's mother
entities.description: The friend who visited James with his mother on 19 October 2022. James said both that she is still serving and that she retired a long time ago. The pair used to tell him stories of their time in the military and of their dog, and the old Nintendo console James played on as a child was theirs.

entities.name: The old Nintendo console
entities.description: The old Nintendo console belonging to James's mother's army friend, with a gamepad James found funny. It was James's first gaming system, and playing Super Mario and The Legend of Zelda on it for hours as a child sparked his passion for gaming.

entities.name: Super Mario
entities.description: One of the games James played for hours as a child on the old Nintendo console, and the game in the childhood photo he showed John on 21 October 2022.

entities.name: The Legend of Zelda
entities.description: A game James played as a child on the old Nintendo console, and the comparison he reached for on 20 September 2022 when John described his own 2D puzzle adventure game.

entities.name: Overwatch
entities.description: One of the games John and his gaming friends played at the charity tournament for a children's hospital on 30 October 2022.

entities.name: FIFA 23
entities.description: The football game John was hooked on in November 2022, playable online against players worldwide. James wanted to try the sports genre with it and said he would practise first.

entities.name: The online board game John co-created
entities.description: The online board game John made with a game developer over the weekend of 5-6 November 2022, seeing his own ideas come to life; a demo was about to be released for others to try.

entities.name: Josh and Mark
entities.description: Two friends of James, taken together, whom he and his family visited early on their November 2022 road trip and had a great time with.

entities.name: Luna
entities.description: The dog belonging to John's cousin, shown to James in a photograph on 7 November 2022; James said Luna is a great name.

claims.text: James told John on 17 March 2022 that video games give him tons of joy and excitement and are what keeps him motivated.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: John said on 17 March 2022 that he is a big video game fan too and that games help him relax after a long day.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: In March 2022 James was most into The Witcher 3, which he said had an amazing story and atmosphere.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: As of 17 March 2022 John had not played The Witcher 3 but had heard it was awesome and meant to try it.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John signed up for a programming class shortly before 17 March 2022.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: James first tried programming once in college, and said on 17 March 2022 that it has since become his whole life.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: John did a bit of HTML and CSS coding a few years before March 2022 and took the programming course to refresh those skills.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: James has worked with Python and C++, has built a website and has created game mods; he showed John a screenshot of one of his mods on 17 March 2022 and John admired its graphics.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: As of 17 March 2022 Python and C++ were the only programming languages James had worked with, though he hoped to learn others in future.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: On 17 March 2022 John suggested that he and James might develop mobile applications together one day, and James liked the idea and proposed an app for dogs.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: In March 2022 James had two dogs, Max and Daisy, whose photo he shared with John.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James described the app he wanted to build as a dog walking and pet care app that would connect pet owners with reliable dog walkers and give helpful pet care information; John thought it would find many buyers.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James said the personal touch would set the dog walking app apart from existing ones: each user could add their own dog's preferences and needs, making it unique for every owner and dog.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James writes all his goals down in a notebook and finds it very satisfying to check each one off; he said creating something and seeing it come to life gives him a great sense of accomplishment.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James is working on a computer game he has wanted to make since he was a child, when he drew the main character in comics; he called it the project that has him really excited.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James said he is making his own game because it combines his two passions, gaming and storytelling, and because he enjoys the challenge of bringing his own ideas to life.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: On 17 March 2022 James promised to keep John updated on his game and said he might invite John to help with parts of it using his HTML knowledge; John said it would be great to work together.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James went bowling on 16 March 2022 and got two strikes; he loves bowling.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: John does not like bowling and says his fingers are too big for it, so he could not share James's enthusiasm for the game.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: On 17 March 2022 John said he should perhaps take up exercise and start going for a run in the mornings.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: James regretted that he and John could not go bowling together, and John suggested slot machines and arcades as something they could do instead.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: The last time James played the slot machines he was so engrossed in the game that his wallet was taken out of his pocket without his noticing; John joked that he would watch James's pockets.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James has tried VR gaming and said it is crazy how real it feels; John proposed it as something the two of them could try together.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: John has tried VR gaming a few times and finds the experience insanely immersive.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: On 17 March 2022 James and John agreed to go VR gaming together on Saturday 19 March 2022.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: Between 17 and 20 March 2022 James made a game avatar and joined a new gaming platform, where he enjoys exploring and chatting with other gamers and feels part of a cool online community.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James said that on the new gaming platform he and other gamers share tips, strategies and stories, that gaming is their shared language regardless of background, and that it has been a refuge for him in tough times.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: John said gaming always helps him escape stress and calms him down during tough times.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: James said games are his go-to when he feels overwhelmed and are like therapy, letting him relax and forget his troubles in another world.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: As of 20 March 2022 James had been checking out different styles of gaming to try something fresh and test himself in new ways.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: John took up a new hobby shortly before 20 March 2022: he bought a metal detector and walks along the beaches looking for something worthwhile.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: With his metal detector John has mostly found bottle caps, but a couple of times he found coins and once a gold ring.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: On 20 March 2022 James showed John a photo of his two dogs enjoying themselves in the park and called them his best pals, saying they have brought a lot of joy to his life.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James's dogs can sit, stay, give a paw and roll over; he has done a lot of training with them, they picked it up fast, and he calls them family.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: On 20 March 2022 John said he badly wants a pet but is not in a position to get one yet, and James offered to help him find the perfect one when he is ready.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: In the week before 27 March 2022 John finally advanced to the next level in his game, which he called a huge confidence booster.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: James started learning the drums a few days before 27 March 2022, has been at it daily and is seeing improvements, calling it tough but rewarding.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: John had been playing the drums for a month as of 27 March 2022, calling it tough but fun, and showed James a picture of his drum kit.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: James got a new cutting-edge gaming system with incredible graphics before 27 March 2022 and has been playing all kinds of new games on it to relax after work and connect with gaming friends.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: Between 20 and 27 March 2022 John went to a gaming convention, where he tried out many games, met developers and took part in a tournament.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: At the gaming convention John competed in an intense tournament in his favourite game CS:GO, and said watching the skilled players there inspired him to improve his own gaming.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John said he is always looking to improve and hit new goals in gaming and in his hobbies, and James said he stays motivated by setting small goals and tracking his progress.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: As of 27 March 2022 James was getting into different types of games, such as RPGs and strategy games, and promised to keep John updated on how the new genres went.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James joined an online gaming tournament on 3 April 2022 and found it intense and fun.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James did well in the 3 April 2022 online tournament, winning some rounds and making it to the semi-finals.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James lost in the final rounds of the 3 April 2022 tournament, but said it was close and he enjoyed competing with talented players and was looking forward to the next one.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: At the 3 April 2022 tournament James met a whole professional team; he did not get a photo with them, but one of them gave him a couple of gaming tips.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: The whole professional team James met at the 3 April 2022 tournament gave him their autographs, which made him very happy.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: The advice James remembers most from the professional player he met is that you must always communicate properly with your team and never put your ego above the team's success.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James usually uses voice chat to communicate with his team, finding it fast and effective.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: Apex Legends is James's favourite game to play with his team; he praises its graphics and very fast-paced gameplay and says it stands out among other games.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: On 4 April 2022 James said he was thinking of trying RPGs and MOBAs next and would tell John what he thought of the new genres.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: In the week before 12 April 2022 James adopted a puppy from a shelter in Stamford and named him Ned, giving him a third dog alongside Max and Daisy; he said his days have been much happier since.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: As of 12 April 2022 John had made little progress on his gaming goals because work and life had been busy, but said gaming makes him happy and is a good way to forget the stresses of life.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: In April 2022 John was playing a new RPG with a cool story and world, which he said was like being transported into a futuristic dystopia.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John said the new RPG he was playing was a little laggy and sometimes produced errors, showing James one he hit on 11 April 2022; James said the game must still be raw and that he would rather wait until the bugs were fixed.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John argued that the RPG was still worth playing despite its minor bugs, for its graphics and immersive gameplay, and offered to send James a link to it.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: James let John persuade him and agreed to try the new RPG once John sent the link, promising to report back with his thoughts.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: On Tuesday 19 April 2022 John met three new friends in his programming course who share his passion, which he was glad to have grown his social circle by.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: James said he gets his ideas from various sources — books, films and even dreams.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: A few weeks before 18 September 2022 James had a vivid dream of a medieval castle with its own labyrinth full of puzzles and traps, which felt like playing a video game in real life and left him with creative ideas.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James made sketches and notes after his castle dream and showed them to John on 18 September 2022.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James said music is a big part of his life, and that the guitar in his sketch had nothing to do with the castle dream.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: John is into electronic and rock music and said on 18 September 2022 that he used to play the drums when he was younger but had not played for a while.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: James said he too likes rock, and that he used to play the guitar when he was younger but had not played in a while.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: John said playing the drums when he was younger was a fun way to let off steam, showed a photo of the old drum set he used to play, and said he had jammed with friends and enjoyed it.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John kept no recordings or videos of his jam sessions with friends, saying it was more about the experience and the moment.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: James started streaming games around 18 September 2022, with no details settled yet, and John wished him luck and asked to hear more.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: On 19 September 2022 John started a new startup making portable smokers and had already welded one out of metal himself, which James said looked great and reminded him of campfires with friends.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: James streamed a game on the evening of 19 September 2022 and was blown away by the nice comments from the gaming community, which left him stoked and inspired to keep going; John congratulated him.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: John announced on 20 September 2022 that he had reached a major career milestone by making his first mobile game, which was due to launch the following month.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John had been working on his first mobile game, a 2D adventure with puzzles and exploration, for the past few months and kept it secret because he would have been upset to have announced it and then failed.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: James said he is into 2D adventures with puzzles like The Legend of Zelda and offered to see or help test John's mobile game; John promised to tell him when testing was ready.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: John used a book full of tips and insights on game design to create the puzzles for his mobile game, and also watches tutorials and follows developer forums to keep learning.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: On 20 September 2022 James recommended a game development magazine to John as a worthy source of information, and John said he reads it too and finds its tutorials, developer interviews and tips really helpful.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James said the game development magazine has been great for him too, full of tutorials and developer interviews that help improve his game development skills.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James said his week up to 20 September 2022 had been good, spent trying to find a balance between work and other activities, while John said his own week had been chaotic but he was powering through.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James urged John to take time for himself and recharge after his chaotic week, and John said he would.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: Around 3 October 2022 John received an email about a volunteer position at a game development non-profit, something he had wanted for a while and which he saw as the perfect start to a career combining gaming and helping people.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: The game development non-profit asked John to be a programming mentor for game developers, teaching coding and assisting with their projects.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John said the mentoring role excited and inspired him as a chance to help others and boost his own skills, and that he hoped it would open more opportunities.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: In the week before 3 October 2022 James got a new video card and was excited to get back into gaming with it.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James said he is really into RPGs and asked John on 3 October 2022 whether Cyberpunk 2077 was worth his attention; John, who had played it, said it was awesome with an immersive world and an amazing story, and James thanked him for the recommendation.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: In the week before 13 October 2022 John and his programmer friends organised an online competition, where he enjoyed seeing everyone show off their skills.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: James announced on 13 October 2022 that he had made his first game and released it for the gaming community, and said it was fulfilling to see players engage with the world he had created and enjoy something he put so much work into.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James said The Witcher 3 gave him a ton of inspiration for the game he released, with its amazing world and story pushing him to create something of his own.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: After releasing his first game James said he was ready to make more games in different genres and test out new ideas.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: On 13 October 2022 John told James his determination and love for game development were incredible and pledged his support, and James thanked him, saying John had always been there for him.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: On 18 October 2022 James's apartment lost power just as he reached the big reveal in the game he was playing, and he had to wait hours before he could play again.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: The 18 October 2022 power cut cost James some of his game progress because he had forgotten to save, and he said he now knows to save more often.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: In the week before 21 October 2022 John organised a programming seminar, which had a great turnout and which he found fulfilling for the chance to share his knowledge.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: At his programming seminar John gained insight into various programming approaches and techniques and found it interesting to hear other developers' ideas and strategies.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John found ideas at the seminar that he can use in his own work but had not yet tried them out as of 21 October 2022, and was looking forward to experimenting.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John promised to send James resources and tutorials on the new programming approaches and techniques he had learned at the seminar, and James said he would reach out if he needed help with them.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: James's mother came to see him on 19 October 2022 with her army friend, and they had fun together.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: On 21 October 2022 James said of his mother's army friend both that she is still serving and that she retired a long time ago; the two of them used to tell him stories about their time in the military and about their dog.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James showed John a photo of himself as a child playing Super Mario on the old Nintendo console belonging to his mother and her army friend, with a gamepad John found funny.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: The Nintendo was James's first gaming system: he played Super Mario and The Legend of Zelda on it for hours as a child, and says those games introduced him to gaming and sparked the passion he has had ever since.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James tried Cyberpunk 2077 on 20 October 2022 and called it a great, addictive game; John said he was glad and warned there would be more unexpected turns than he could imagine.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: John told James the hardest thing in Cyberpunk 2077 is making the right choice, because even the choice of lines in dialogue with characters can make everything go wrong, and that the choices can be life-changing.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John advised James, without spoiling it, that he does not have to be friends with every character in Cyberpunk 2077, and James said he would keep it in mind.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: On the evening of 30 October 2022 John held a gaming tournament with his friends, playing Fortnite among other games, and they raised a decent amount for a children's hospital.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: At the 30 October 2022 charity tournament John and his gaming friends also played Overwatch and Apex Legends; he said the atmosphere was competitive and it felt good to use their love of gaming for the children's hospital.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John shared a photo from the 30 October 2022 charity tournament and called it a really awesome, unforgettable moment for everyone there.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: On 31 October 2022 James told John that he and Samantha had decided to move in together, calling it a mutual and informed decision.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James and Samantha rented an apartment not far from McGee's bar, and James admitted that having that particular bar nearby was one of their criteria for choosing it.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: John wished James and Samantha luck with the move and asked to be kept posted; James said he appreciated the support.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: On 4 November 2022 James and his family set off on a road trip with his dogs, exploring new places and enjoying nature together.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: John won the regional chess tournament on Tuesday 1 November 2022, calling it intense but coming out on top.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John said winning the regional chess tournament felt great, that his hard work and practice had paid off, and that it gave him a huge confidence boost.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John's strategy in the regional chess tournament was to analyse and anticipate his opponent's moves so as to stay one step ahead.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John's advice for improving at chess is to study opening moves and strategies, learn from experienced players and analyse past games, and he said the chess advice James gave him earlier had also helped.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: On 5 November 2022 John shared a resource on chess openings with James, who had asked for one.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: In November 2022 John was hooked on FIFA 23, a football game that can be played online against players all over the world.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: James decided to try the sports genre with FIFA 23 and agreed to practise first so that he and John could play together; John told him all he needs is a gamepad and a sense of timing.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: By 7 November 2022 James and his family were still on their road trip and had already visited his friends Josh and Mark, with whom they had a great time.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: Over the weekend of 5 and 6 November 2022 John worked with a game developer on a project and found it incredible to see his own ideas come to life.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: The project John worked on with a game developer that weekend was an online board game, which he called a fun and unique experience.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John said a demo of the online board game was about to be released so others could try it, and he was looking forward to their feedback; James asked to be kept posted so he could support it and give his thoughts.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: On the way to Josh and Mark during the November 2022 road trip, James and his family visited an animal sanctuary full of rescue dogs, which made him think of his and John's love of dogs.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James said the rescue dogs at the sanctuary were so cute he wanted to take them all home, but that he already has three dogs and thinks more than three would be too much.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: As of 7 November 2022 John still had not got a dog although he really wants one, and asked James what having one is like; James said having furry friends brings so much joy and friendship that life would not be the same without them.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: James said his dogs make even dark days better and that he does not know what he would do without them, and John agreed that dogs give a daily dose of positivity and accept us without judgement.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: On 7 November 2022 John showed James a photo of his cousin's dog, whose name is Luna; James said Luna is a great name.
claims.speaker: John
